Name: Kat's Simple Shed
Author: katriex
Description:
[center][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]Mod Description[/b][/size][/color]
Hi! This is my first map mod!
It's just a simple shed redesign designed for users like myself who want slightly fancier looking & slightly larger sheds, but didn't find anything that fit the bill. I tend to use my sheds almost exclusively for putting as many kegs and other machines in them as I can, so I always found some other shed maps that make it a new layout entirely to be mildly annoying to work with. This remedies that by just making the shed a little bit larger while keeping the rectangular shape!

You can place different wallpapers on each section of the wall, just use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿ to walk up and place it on the higher sections!
[size=2](I feel like there's probably another way of doing this, but it's what I do and it's not horribly difficult, lmao.)[/size]

[color=#ea9999][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
1. Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed.
2. Download this mod.
3. Extract this mod into your Mods folder. (right click > extract)
4. Enjoy! It should be ready to go.
You'll need to reopen Stardrop in order for the mod to show up, or restart SMAPI if your game is open already.


[color=#ea9999][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
This mod SHOULD be compatible with most recolors/interior mods, as long as you're not also trying to use another mod that changes the vanilla shed maps. It uses vanilla tilesheets only, so any recolors you have that affect the beams should work on it just fine![/center][center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24533]Beams Color Change[/url]﻿ ✅ (Pictured in mod screenshots above)
Recolor mods that touch interior tilesheets ✅
Virtually anything else should be fine, as this mod solely touches the shed maps. If you run into anything that breaks the mod, please go to [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] and comment or submit a bug report with your log so I can take a look at it!
